youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用掃碼支付情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從小店結帳問能不能掃碼、打開App綁卡輸入金額、付款失敗重新嘗試，到對帳退款與朋友AA收款，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical QR Code Payments phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering asking to scan at a small shop, linking your card and typing the amount, retrying a failed payment, and handling refunds or splitting the bill. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, can I get two egg sandwiches?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, kæn aɪ ɡɛt tu ɛɡ ˈsænwɪtʃɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我要兩個蛋三明治，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, anything to drink with that?
dialogue.zh: 好的，還要搭配什麼喝的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just water, please. How much is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈwɔtər, pliz. haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 只要水就好。總共多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's eight fifty, all together.
dialogue.zh: 全部共八十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to scan this order?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ tə skæn ðɪs ˈɔrdər?/
dialogue.zh: 全部共八塊五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we take QR code payments.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們收掃描碼付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Where is your payment code?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你們的付款碼在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's right here on the counter.
dialogue.zh: 就在櫃台這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this small square the code?
dialogue.zh: 這個小方塊就是碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one. Just scan it.
dialogue.zh: 就是這個，掃下去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to download an app?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə ˈdaʊnˌloʊd æn æp?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要下載一個應用程式嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your bank app works fine too.
dialogue.zh: 你用銀行的App也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, let me open my camera.
dialogue.zh: 好，我打開相機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, I'll bag your food.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，我先把餐裝袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, this code looks a bit blurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, ðɪs ˈkoʊd lʊks ə bɪt ˈblɜri./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這個碼看起來有點模糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, let me wipe the sticker.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我把貼紙擦一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better now? I can see it clearly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər naʊ? aɪ kæn si ɪt ˈklɪrli./
dialogue.zh: 現在好多了？我看得清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it one more try, please.
dialogue.zh: 請你再掃一次試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost… yes, a link popped up.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了……有了，跳出一個連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Enter the amount there.
dialogue.zh: 很好，在那邊輸入金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I type eight dollars fifty?
dialogue.zh: 我輸入八塊五十嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and check the name first.
dialogue.zh: 對，不過先看一眼名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shop name shows as Bright Corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑp neɪm ʃoʊz æz braɪt ˈkɔrnər?/
dialogue.zh: 店名顯示的是 Bright Corner？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's us. We renamed it last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ʌs. wi rɪˈneɪmd ɪt læst mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 是我們上個月改的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Do you accept coupons?
dialogue.zh: 了解。你們收折價券嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the paper kind from today.
dialogue.zh: 只收今天的紙本券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my flyer for one dollar off.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz maɪ ˈflaɪər fər wʌn ˈdɑlər ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 這張傳單可以折一美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, so that's seven fifty now.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，那現在是七塊五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me change the number quickly.
dialogue.zh: 我快速改一下數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, no problem.
dialogue.zh: 不急，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the total on your screen too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈtoʊtəl ɑn jʊr skrin tu?/
dialogue.zh: 你的螢幕上看得到總額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I see every payment here.
dialogue.zh: 可以，每一筆款項我都看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you keep receipts with this?
dialogue.zh: 這樣會留下收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app saves them automatically.
dialogue.zh: App 會自動幫你存起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my paper receipts always fade.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的紙本收據常會褪色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, that's why we switched.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，所以我們才改用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When did you start using codes?
dialogue.zh: 你們什麼時候開始用掃描碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last winter, after the market moved.
dialogue.zh: 去年冬天，市場搬家之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do customers like paying that way?
dialogue.zh: 顧客喜歡這種付款方式嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most do, especially in a rush.
dialogue.zh: 大部分喜歡，特別是趕時間的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some older folks may find it hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈoʊldər foʊks meɪ faɪnd ɪt hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 有些長輩可能會覺得不方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We still take cash for them.
dialogue.zh: 我們還是收現金讓他們安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my grandma hates new things.
dialogue.zh: 這樣很好，我奶奶討厭新東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! She's not alone in that.
dialogue.zh: 哈！不只她這樣想。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I typed the new amount.
dialogue.zh: 好，我輸入新的金額了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then press the green pay button.
dialogue.zh: 接著按綠色的付款按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks for my password now.
dialogue.zh: 它現在要我的密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal, it keeps money safe.
dialogue.zh: 那很正常，是為保護錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I use a fingerprint instead.
dialogue.zh: 我改成用指紋驗證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even faster. Go ahead and touch it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈfæstər. ɡoʊ əˈhɛd ənd tʊtʃ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那樣更快，直接按上去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, does this take my card number?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, dʌz ðɪs teɪk maɪ kɑrd ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，這會取得我的卡號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the code only sees the wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə ˈkoʊd ˈoʊnli siz ðə ˈwɑlət./
dialogue.zh: 不會，碼只看得到你的錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel a lot better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks mi fil ə lɑt ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 這樣我就放心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We never touch your card details.
dialogue.zh: 我們碰不到你的卡片資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a limit per payment?
dialogue.zh: 每筆付款有額度上限嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, codes cap at two hundred.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡掃描碼上限是兩百塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing my order is small.
dialogue.zh: 還好我買的數量不多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For big tickets, use a bank transfer.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər bɪɡ ˈtɪkəts, juz ə bæŋk ˈtrænsfər./
dialogue.zh: 金額大的話就用銀行轉帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I send money to a friend?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɛnd ˈmʌni tə ə frɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以用它轉錢給朋友嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the same app does that.
dialogue.zh: 可以，同一個 App 就能轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it work at other stalls?
dialogue.zh: 其他攤位也收這種碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly every vendor here uses it.
dialogue.zh: 這裡幾乎每個攤商都在用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One shop made me scan twice.
dialogue.zh: 有一家店讓我掃了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was probably the old code.
dialogue.zh: 那個大概是以前的舊碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You change your codes sometimes?
dialogue.zh: 你們偶爾會換碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when the sticker gets damaged.
dialogue.zh: 只有貼紙破掉的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, that explains the blurry one.
dialogue.zh: 啊，難怪剛才那個那麼模糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rain ruins them every summer.
dialogue.zh: 每年夏天雨水都會把它們泡壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It timed out, so I'll scan once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt taɪmd aʊt, soʊ aɪl skæn wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 頁面過期了，所以我再掃一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunlight can wash out a code fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌlaɪt kæn wɑʃ aʊt ə ˈkoʊd fæst./
dialogue.zh: 太陽光很快就會讓碼掃不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a shady spot I can use?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈʃeɪdi spɑt aɪ kæn juz?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有陰暗一點的位置可以用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the corner away from the sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈkɔrnər əˈweɪ frʌm ðə sʌn./
dialogue.zh: 你試試那邊躲開太陽的角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go, it scanned this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr wi ɡoʊ, ɪt skænd ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 好了，這次掃起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I heard the little confirmation beep.
dialogue.zh: 我聽到那聲小小的確認嗶聲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that beep come from your phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt bip kʌm frʌm jʊr foʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 那聲嗶是來自你的手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my speaker rings for each sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, maɪ ˈspikər rɪŋz fər itʃ seɪl./
dialogue.zh: 對，每筆成交都會播音效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps you avoid missing money.
dialogue.zh: 這樣你就不會漏收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, especially at busy lunch hours.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，午餐尖峰時尤其重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I watch you confirm the payment?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ wɑtʃ ju kənˈfɜrm ðə ˈpeɪmənt?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以看你確認這筆款項嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, it says received, seven fifty.
dialogue.zh: 你看，上面寫已收款七塊五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I show you my screen again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ʃoʊ ju maɪ skrin əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我要再把螢幕給你看一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, but that's fine too.
dialogue.zh: 不用了，不過給我看也好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine says pending for a second.
dialogue.zh: 我這邊先是顯示處理中。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It usually clears within ten seconds.
dialogue.zh: 通常十秒內就會完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it shows a green check mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ʃoʊz ə ɡrɪn tʃɛk mɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 現在出現綠色的對勾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, you're all paid up.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你付清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, is there a receipt in my bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ, ɪz ðɛr ə rəˈsɪt ɪn maɪ bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 嘿，我的袋子裡有收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No paper, but the app has proof.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpeɪər, bʌt ðə æp hæz pruf./
dialogue.zh: 沒有紙本，不過App裡有憑證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I trust that more than a slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ trʌst ðæt mɔr ðæn ə slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我比較相信那個勝過紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, slips vanish from pockets.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，小紙條常常就不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for being so patient with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər ˈbiɪŋ soʊ ˈpeɪʃənt wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你這麼有耐心地幫我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, you asked good questions.
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，你的問題問得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the sandwiches still warm in the bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈsænwɪtʃɪz stɪl wɔrm ɪn ðə bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 三明治在袋子裡還溫著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrapped those last, so yes.
dialogue.zh: 我最後才把它們包起來，還溫著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, where's the trash bin?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ, wɛrz ðə træʃ bɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，垃圾桶在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just past the fruit cart outside.
dialogue.zh: 就在外面水果車過去一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll come back tomorrow for coffee.
dialogue.zh: 我明天再來買咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our code will be in the same spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈkoʊd wɪl bi ɪn ðə seɪm spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我們的碼還是在同樣的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you then, and thanks again.
dialogue.zh: 到時見，再次謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a good afternoon, take care!
dialogue.zh: 下午愉快，慢用！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set up the payment app now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛt ʌp ðə ˈpeɪmənt æp naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在要把付款App設好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, then scanning is easy.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，之後掃碼就輕鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which app should I download first?
dialogue.zh: 我該先下載哪個 App？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Search the store and pick the blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɜrtʃ ðə stɔr ənd pɪk ðə blu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 在應用商店搜尋，選那個藍色圖示的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one says it needs my phone number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn sɛz ɪt nidz maɪ foʊn ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 這個要求輸入我的手機號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they send a code by text.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ sɛnd ə ˈkoʊd baɪ tɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 對，他們會用簡訊傳驗證碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I got a six digit message.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ ɡɑt ə sɪks ˈdɪdʒɪt ˈmɛsɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我收到一則六位數的簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it in before it expires.
dialogue.zh: 趁它過期前快打進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It expired already. That was fast.
dialogue.zh: 已經過期了，也太快了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for a new one, it takes seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fər ə nju wʌn, ɪt teɪks ˈsɛkəndz./
dialogue.zh: 重新要一組，只要幾秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it wants an email address.
dialogue.zh: 現在它要電子郵件地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the one you check every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ði wʌn ju tʃɛk ˈɛvri deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 用你每天都會看的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. It asked me to make a password.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn. ɪt æskt mi tə meɪk ə ˈpæswərd./
dialogue.zh: 好了，它叫我自己設密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make it long and save it somewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ɪt lɔŋ ənd seɪv ɪt ˈsɛmwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 設長一點，然後記在安全的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use my birthday again?
dialogue.zh: 我可以再用我的生日嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't, that's too easy to guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz dont, ðæts tu ˈizɪ tə ɡɛs./
dialogue.zh: 千萬別，那個太容易被猜到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll write one down on paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, aɪl raɪt wʌn daʊn ɑn ˈpeɪər./
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我寫在紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it away from your wallet.
dialogue.zh: 別跟錢包放一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next step is adding a bank card.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst stɛp ɪz ˈædɪŋ ə bæŋk kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 下一步是綁銀行卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can snap a photo of the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn snæp ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 你可以直接幫卡片拍張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? The numbers read clearly.
dialogue.zh: 這樣可以嗎？數字看得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now check the last four digits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, naʊ tʃɛk ðə læst fɔr ˈdɪdʒɪts./
dialogue.zh: 很好，接著核對末四碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows the card ending in nine two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz ðə kɑrd ˈɛndɪŋ ɪn naɪn tu./
dialogue.zh: 它顯示那張尾數九二的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's your older card, right?
dialogue.zh: 那是你較舊的卡，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I want the new one from Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, aɪ wɑnt ðə nju wʌn frʌm ˈmʌndeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不對，我要週一那張新卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delete that entry and scan the other.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈlit ðæt ˈɛntri ənd skæn ði ˈʌðər./
dialogue.zh: 把那筆刪掉，再掃另一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks for the expiration and security code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks fər ði ˌɛkpəˈreɪʃən ənd sɪˈkjʊrəti ˈkoʊd./
dialogue.zh: 它要有效期限和安全碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never share those with anyone else.
dialogue.zh: 那兩組絕對不能給別人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, only the app sees them.
dialogue.zh: 我懂了，只有App看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, that's the whole point.
dialogue.zh: 對，重點就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add a second card too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ æd ə ˈsɛkənd kɑrd tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我要再綁第二張卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then pick a default one.
dialogue.zh: 可以，然後選一張當預設。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My main card becomes the default.
dialogue.zh: 我的主力卡當預設。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, backups matter when money is low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ˈbækˌʌps ˈmætər wɛn ˈmʌni ɪz loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 很好，錢不夠時備用卡就派上用場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says verification is pending.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫驗證中。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually your bank calls to confirm.
dialogue.zh: 通常你的銀行會打來確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll answer unknown numbers today.
dialogue.zh: 好，今天我會接陌生電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They only ask two simple questions.
dialogue.zh: 他們只會問兩個簡單的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bank approved my card just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæŋk əˈpruvd maɪ kɑrd dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 銀行剛剛通過我的卡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, your wallet is ready to use.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, jʊr ˈwɑlət ɪz ˈrɛdi tə juz./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你的錢包可以用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need money inside the wallet?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ˈmʌni ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈwɑlət?/
dialogue.zh: 錢包裡需要先存錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it pulls from the linked card.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt pʊlz frʌm ðə lɪŋkt kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 不用，它會從綁好的卡扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I also load cash into it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ loʊd kæʃ ˈɪntu ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我也可以往裡充值嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, at any kiosk with your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, æt ˈɛni ˈkiɑsk wɪð jʊr kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 可以，在自助機用你的卡儲值。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me add fifty for small purchases.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi æd ˈfɪfti fər smɔl ˈpɜrtʃəsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我先充五十塊買小東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's smart, it keeps spending low.
dialogue.zh: 真聰明，這樣會花得少一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My balance now shows fifty dollars.
dialogue.zh: 我的餘額現在顯示五十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And each payment comes off that first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd itʃ ˈpeɪmənt kʌmz ɔf ðæt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 每筆付款會先從那裡扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should turn on spending alerts.
dialogue.zh: 我該把消費提醒打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then you see every charge instantly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛn ju si ˈɛvri tʃɑrdʒ ˈɪnstəntli./
dialogue.zh: 對，那樣每筆扣款你馬上知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I set a monthly limit?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ sɛt ə ˈmʌnθli ˈlɪmət?/
dialogue.zh: 月度限額要怎麼設？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a controls tab in settings.
dialogue.zh: 設定裡有一個控制項分頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll cap it at three hundred.
dialogue.zh: 我就設上限三百塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That keeps late night shopping safe.
dialogue.zh: 這樣半夜亂買也比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my kid use this app?
dialogue.zh: 我小孩能用這個App嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, but you can make a family card.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, bʌt ju kæn meɪk ə ˈfæməli kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 還不行，但可以辦家庭卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me more about the family card.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi mɔr əˈbaʊt ðə ˈfæməli kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 家庭卡再多跟我說說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You set an allowance and watch it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛt ən əˈlaʊəns ənd wɑtʃ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你設好零用錢額度，還能追蹤花去哪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, he can scan for lunch too.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, hi kæn skæn fər lʌntʃ tu./
dialogue.zh: 不錯，他買午餐也能掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just make sure his phone stays charged.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst meɪk ʃʊr hɪz foʊn steɪz tʃɑrdʒt./
dialogue.zh: 只要確保他手機有電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's try it at the corner store.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛts traɪ ɪt æt ðə ˈkɔrnər stɔr./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們到巷口商店試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab a basket and I'll walk with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb ə ˈbæskət ənd aɪl wɔk wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 拿個籃子，我陪你過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three bags of chips and a bottle of juice.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri bæɡz ʌv tʃɪps ənd ə ˈbɑtəl ʌv dʒus./
dialogue.zh: 三包薯片還有一瓶果汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's six ninety at the register.
dialogue.zh: 收銀台那邊是六塊九十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, opening the app, tapping the scan button.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˈoʊpənɪŋ ðə æp, ˈtæpɪŋ ðə skæn ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 好，打開 App，再點掃描按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point the box at the clerk's code.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt ðə bɑks æt ðə klɜrkz ˈkoʊd./
dialogue.zh: 把方框對準店員的碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It found the code right away.
dialogue.zh: 它一下子就找到碼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The amount filled in for you.
dialogue.zh: 金額已經自動填好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six ninety, exactly what she said.
dialogue.zh: 六塊九十，跟她講的一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Confirm it, then press the pay button.
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈfɜrm ɪt, ðɛn prɛs ðə peɪ ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 先確認，再按付款按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thumbprint went through right away.
dialogue.zh: 指紋驗證一下就通過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the clerk hear her beep?
dialogue.zh: 店員那邊有聽到嗶聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, she says it landed on her screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʃi sɛz ɪt ˈlændɪd ɑn hər skrin./
dialogue.zh: 有，她說她螢幕上收到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're finished, no change needed.
dialogue.zh: 那就結了，不用找零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This beats counting coins in a line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bits ˈkaʊntɪŋ kɔɪnz ɪn a laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這比排隊數硬幣好太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Especially when the bag is in your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈspɛʃli wɛn ðə bæɡ ɪz ɪn jʊr hænd./
dialogue.zh: 尤其手上還提著袋子的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a note here called receipt detail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə noʊt hɪr kɔld rəˈsɪt dɪˈteɪl./
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一行寫收據明細。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it, it shows the store and time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt, ɪt ʃoʊz ðə stɔr ənd taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 打開看，它會顯示店家和時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It even lists my item names.
dialogue.zh: 它還列出我買的商品名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some stores send that, some don't.
dialogue.zh: 有些店會傳，有些不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep this for my records?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kip ðɪs fər maɪ ˈrɛkərdz?/
dialogue.zh: 這筆我要留下來對帳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it one month, then it archives.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt wʌn mʌnθ, ðɛn ɪt ˈɑrˌkaɪvz./
dialogue.zh: 留一個月，之後會自動歸檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, there's another code by the register.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðɛrz əˈnʌðər ˈkoʊd baɪ ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər./
dialogue.zh: 你看，收銀台旁邊還有一個碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is for the loyalty club.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz fər ðə ˈlɔɪəlti klʌb./
dialogue.zh: 那個是會員積點的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign up before paying?
dialogue.zh: 我該在付款前先註冊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, free points on every purchase.
dialogue.zh: 對，每次消費都能累積點數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I scan it and give my birthday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ skæn ɪt ənd ɡɪv maɪ ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我掃了碼，填下生日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you get a free birthday drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ju ɡɛt ə fri ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ drɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 現在你生日當天能領一杯免費飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a nice little bonus.
dialogue.zh: 那個小獎勵挺不錯的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scan the loyalty code each visit.
dialogue.zh: 每次來都要掃會員碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the store has no code?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə stɔr hæz noʊ ˈkoʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 如果店內沒有碼怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then they scan the one on your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðeɪ skæn ði wʌn ɑn jʊr foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 那就由店員掃你手機上的碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my own code in the app?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz maɪ ˈoʊn ˈkoʊd ɪn ði æp?/
dialogue.zh: 我自己的碼在App哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap pay and it shows a barcode.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp peɪ ənd ɪt ʃoʊz ə ˈbɑrˌkoʊd./
dialogue.zh: 點付款，就會出現一條條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cashier aimed his scanner at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæˈʃɪr eɪmd hɪz ˈskænər æt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 收銀員把掃描機對著它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it worked in less than a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd ɪt wɜrkt ɪn lɛs ðæn ə ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 不到一秒就完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two ways to pay with one app.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu weɪz tə peɪ wɪð wʌn æp./
dialogue.zh: 一個App有兩種付款方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why everyone uses it now.
dialogue.zh: 所以現在大家都在用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel ready to try this anywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈrɛdi tə traɪ ðɪs ˈɛnɪˌwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我覺得到哪都能用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until the day the network fails you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈtɪl ðə deɪ ðə ˈnɜtwɜrk felz ju./
dialogue.zh: 直到哪天網路當機就不一定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, scanning at the food court now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˈskænɪŋ æt ðə fud kɔrt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我在美食街這邊掃碼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same steps as the corner store today.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm stɛps æz ðə ˈkɔrnər stɔr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 跟今天巷口商店的步驟一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It spins and spins… nothing happens.
dialogue.zh: 它轉啊轉的……什麼都沒有發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That looks like a network problem.
dialogue.zh: 那看起來是網路的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen says payment failed.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上寫付款失敗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't pay twice, wait a minute.
dialogue.zh: 別付兩次，先等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I press the button again?
dialogue.zh: 我要再按一次按鈕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, check your connection first.
dialogue.zh: 先別，檢查一下網路連線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wifi bars are completely gone.
dialogue.zh: 我的 wifi 訊號格全沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn your mobile data on instead.
dialogue.zh: 改成打開手機的行動網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, I have two bars now.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，現在有兩格訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the scan one more time.
dialogue.zh: 再掃一次看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same error again. Wonderful.
dialogue.zh: 又是同樣的錯誤，真是太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What error number does it show you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈɛrər ˈnʌmbər dʌz ɪt ʃoʊ ju?/
dialogue.zh: 它顯示哪一個錯誤編號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says error five zero three.
dialogue.zh: 它寫錯誤代碼五零三。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That usually means the server is busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈjuʒəwəli minz ðə ˈsɜrvər ɪz ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 那通常代表伺服器太忙碌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the whole system down here?
dialogue.zh: 這邊的系統整個掛掉了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two other customers complained already.
dialogue.zh: 已經有兩位客人在抱怨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nobody can pay by code today?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈnoʊbədi kæn peɪ baɪ ˈkoʊd təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那今天沒人能用碼付款了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some succeed, it comes and goes.
dialogue.zh: 還是有人成功，時好時壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I just pay with cash instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ dʒʌst peɪ wɪð kæʃ ɪnˈstɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以直接改用現金付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll take bills no problem.
dialogue.zh: 可以，紙鈔我照收沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I only have coins with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv kɔɪnz wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 可是我身上只有硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coins are fine too, no rush.
dialogue.zh: 硬幣也可以，不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me close the app completely.
dialogue.zh: 我把App整個關掉看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swipe it away and open it fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /swaɪp ɪt əˈweɪ ənd ˈoʊpən ɪt frɛʃ./
dialogue.zh: 往上推關掉，再重新打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, now it wants a fresh login.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, naʊ ɪt wɑnts ə frɛʃ ˈlɑɡˌɪn./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在它又要我重新登入。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Password, or the fingerprint works too.
dialogue.zh: 密碼或指紋都可以登入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I forgot it already, how embarrassing.
dialogue.zh: 我竟然就忘了，真尷尬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a link for a reset code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə lɪŋk fər ə riˈsɛt ˈkoʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那邊有個連結可以重設密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The reset text never arrived.
dialogue.zh: 重設的簡訊都沒收到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try looking inside your spam folder.
dialogue.zh: 你到垃圾訊息匣裡找找看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, the message was hiding there.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt, ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ wəz ˈhaɪdɪŋ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，原來藏在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, set a new password quickly.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，快設一個新密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, and I saved it this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ənd aɪ seɪvd ɪt ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 設好了，這次我記起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now try your pending payment again.
dialogue.zh: 現在再試你那筆待付的款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says the order expired online.
dialogue.zh: 它說那筆訂單在線上過期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you'll need a brand new scan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jul nid ə brænd nu skæn./
dialogue.zh: 那你就需要重新掃一次碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, one more scan at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, wʌn mɔr skæn æt ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 好，在櫃台再掃一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same noodles, twelve dollars this time.
dialogue.zh: 同一份麵，這次是十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, why twelve and not ten?
dialogue.zh: 哇，怎麼是十二不是十？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first price didn't include tax.
dialogue.zh: 那個舊價格還沒含稅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I type twelve and press pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ taɪp twɛlv ənd prɛs peɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我輸入十二再按付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's wait for the beep together.
dialogue.zh: 我們一起等那聲確認音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still nothing on my side.
dialogue.zh: 我這邊還是沒有任何動靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My register shows no charge either.
dialogue.zh: 我的收銀機也沒有進帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So awkward, everyone behind us is waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɔkwərd, ˈɛvriˌwʌn bɪˈhaʊnd ʌs ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好尷尬，後面全都是排隊的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step aside, I'll bring the order over.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp əˈsaɪd, aɪl brɪŋ ði ˈɔrdər ˈoʊvər./
dialogue.zh: 你先站到旁邊，我把點單拿過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe my card got blocked today.
dialogue.zh: 可能是我的卡被擋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for a message from your bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fər ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ frʌm jʊr bæŋk./
dialogue.zh: 找找看有沒有銀行的訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! A fraud warning froze my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! ə frɔd ˈwɔrnɪŋ froʊz maɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 有！一條防詐欺警告把我的卡凍結了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap verify and answer their questions.
dialogue.zh: 點驗證，回答他們的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They want a photo of my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɑnt ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv maɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 他們要我的卡片照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover the middle digits, keep it safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvər ðə ˈmɪdəl ˈdɪdʒɪts, kip ɪt seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 把中間幾碼遮起來，比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart tip, I didn't think of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt tɪp, aɪ ˈdɪdənt θɪŋk ʌv ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 這建議真好，我沒想到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Upload it and the hold disappears.
dialogue.zh: 上傳之後凍結就會解開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That took five whole minutes.
dialogue.zh: 那花了整整五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But look, your wallet is active again.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt lʊk, jʊr ˈwɑlət ɪz ˈæktɪv əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 但是你看，你的錢包又可使用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me retry the same twelve dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi rɪˈtraɪ ðə seɪm twɛlv ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 我再試一次同樣的十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, now the spinner is moving fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, naʊ ðə ˈspɪnər ɪz ˈmuvɪŋ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 好，這次轉圈跑得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says success at last!
dialogue.zh: 終於顯示成功了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There it is, my register beeped!
dialogue.zh: 來了，我的收銀機嗶一聲進帳了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for not rushing me there.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你剛剛沒有催我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You handled it like a pro.
dialogue.zh: 你處理得超像老手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my history shows two charges.
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的紀錄出現兩筆扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That may be only the failed one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪ bi ˈoʊnli ðə fæld wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那可能只是失敗的那筆紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both are twelve, same minute, same shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɑr twɛlv, seɪm ˈmɪnɪt, seɪm ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 兩筆都是十二塊，同一分鐘同店家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the details on the older entry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə dɪˈteɪlz ɑn ði ˈoʊldər ˈɛntri./
dialogue.zh: 打開較早那筆的明細看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's marked failed, not completed.
dialogue.zh: 它標成失敗，不是完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no money left your account there.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ ˈmʌni lɛft jʊr əˈkaʊnt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 所以那筆沒有真的扣錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relief, I panicked for a second.
dialogue.zh: 鬆了一口氣，我剛剛嚇到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That double line scares everyone.
dialogue.zh: 那重複的兩行誰看到都怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the failed one disappear?
dialogue.zh: 失敗那筆會自己消失嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually within one or two days.
dialogue.zh: 通常一兩天內就會不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I contact support about it?
dialogue.zh: 我要聯絡客服問這事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if it stays after tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 如果明天還在就要找客服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's their number if I need it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wæts ðɛr ˈnʌmbər ɪf aɪ nid ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 需要時他們的電話是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in the app under help center.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɪn ði æp ˈʌndər hɛlp ˈsɛntər./
dialogue.zh: 就在App的幫助中心裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They promise an answer within hours.
dialogue.zh: 他們承諾幾小時內回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save your order id in a note first.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv jʊr ˈɔrdər ˌaɪˈdi ɪn ə noʊt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先把訂單編號記在備忘錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copied, with the time and amount.
dialogue.zh: 複製好了，含時間和金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's all they ever ask you for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɔl ðeɪ ˈɛvər æsk ju fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 客服要的就是這些資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these outages happen a lot here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz ˈaʊtˌɪdʒɪz ˈhæpən ə lɑt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這邊常發生這種斷線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a month, mostly at lunch.
dialogue.zh: 一個月約兩次，多在午餐時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I should always carry some cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ ʃʊd ˈɔlweɪz ˈkæri sʌm kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 所以我該隨身帶點現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep small bills in your jacket.
dialogue.zh: 在外套裡放幾張小鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good advice, my wallet is all codes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ædˈvaɪs, maɪ ˈwɑlət ɪz ɔl ˈkoʊdz./
dialogue.zh: 說得對，我錢包全是碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few bills can save your day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fjʊ bɪlz kæn seɪv jʊr deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 幾張紙鈔能救你一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also my battery is at four percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ maɪ ˈbætəri ɪz æt fɔr pərˈsɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 而且我的電量只剩百分之四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then borrow a charger at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈbæroʊ ə ˈtʃɑrdʒər æt ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 那就向櫃台借一條充電線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dead phone means no payment at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɛd foʊn minz noʊ ˈpeɪmənt æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 手機沒電就完全付不了錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's exactly why cash still matters.
dialogue.zh: 這就是現金仍然重要的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the charger, thanks for waiting.
dialogue.zh: 充電線拿到了，謝謝等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten more minutes and you're fully safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnɪts ənd jʊr ˈfʊli seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 再充電十分你就萬無一失。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is alive and paid up now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz əˈlaɪv ənd peɪd ʌp naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我手機活了，款也付清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your noodles are getting cold, go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd jʊr ˈnudəlz ɑr ˈɡɛtɪŋ koʊld, ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你的麵要涼了，快去吃吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll pay before I sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪl peɪ bɪˈfɔr aɪ sɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 下次我要先付款再坐下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move when the signal is weak.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt muv wɛn ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ɪz wik./
dialogue.zh: 訊號弱的時候那樣最聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more lesson: screenshot every receipt.
dialogue.zh: 還有一課：每張收據都截圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That will settle any future argument fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɪl ˈsɛtəl ˈɛni ˈfjutʃər ˈɑrɡjəmənt fæst./
dialogue.zh: 那能很快解決日後爭議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check this month's payment list.
dialogue.zh: 我們來看看這個月的付款清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the history tab and start reading.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə ˈhɪstrəri tæb ənd stɑrt ˈridɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 打開紀錄分頁，逐筆看過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I count forty-two small charges.
dialogue.zh: 我數到四十二筆小額扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most of them are code payments.
dialogue.zh: 其中大部分是掃碼付的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three coffee shops, twelve mornings.
dialogue.zh: 三家咖啡店，十二個早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You really love that corner place.
dialogue.zh: 你真的很愛那間巷口的店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did the big fifty go?
dialogue.zh: 那筆五十塊大額的去哪了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the group dinner last Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ðə ɡrup ˈdɪnər læst ˈfraɪˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那是上週五大家聚餐的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, I paid for everyone then.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt, aɪ peɪd fər ˈɛvriˌwʌn ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 噢對，那頓我先幫大家付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did your friends send it back?
dialogue.zh: 你朋友有把錢還給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, I'll ask them tonight.
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我今晚來問他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app can request money from them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp kən rɪˈkwɛst ˈmʌni frʌm ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: App 裡可以直接向他們請款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does that request work?
dialogue.zh: 那個請款要怎麼用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You tap it and pick a friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tæp ɪt ənd pɪk ə frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 點它，然後選一位朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add a short note?
dialogue.zh: 我要加一句備註嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, write dinner share from Friday.
dialogue.zh: 要，寫上週五餐費分攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent to all four of them.
dialogue.zh: 已經發給他們四個人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now wait for their green checks.
dialogue.zh: 現在就等他們那邊變綠勾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One paid already, two are typing.
dialogue.zh: 一位付了，兩位還在打訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last one may need a reminder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst wʌn meɪ nid ə rɪˈmaɪndər./
dialogue.zh: 最後那位可能需要提醒一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll nudge him after lunch.
dialogue.zh: 午餐後我再輕催他一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Requests expire after seven days.
dialogue.zh: 請款單七天後會失效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, I'll watch that.
dialogue.zh: 還好我知道了，會注意時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Money moves fast when you ask nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌni muvz fæst wɛn ju æsk ˈnaɪsli./
dialogue.zh: 好好開口，錢就回來得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the refund from the shoe store?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈriˌfʌnd frʌm ðə ʃu stɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 那間鞋店的退款怎麼樣了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you return those wet sneakers?
dialogue.zh: 你有退回那雙濕的球鞋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, they took them last Monday.
dialogue.zh: 有，他們上週一收回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Refunds usually take three to five days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈriˌfʌndz ˈjuʒəwəli teɪk θri tə faɪv deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 退款通常要花三到五天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's been six days already.
dialogue.zh: 已經超過六天了耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the status inside your order list.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈstætəs ɪnˈsaɪd jʊr ˈɔrdər lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 到你的訂單清單裡看狀態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says approved but no money.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫已核準，但錢還沒進。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then call them with the receipt code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kɔl ðɛm wɪð ðə rəˈsɪt ˈkoʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那就拿著收據編號打電話過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I read them the code over the phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rɛd ðɛm ðə koʊd ˈoʊvər ðə foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我在電話上把碼念給了他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask if it lands in card or wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪf ɪt ˈlændz ɪn kɑrd ɔr ˈwɑlət./
dialogue.zh: 問清楚錢會退到卡片還是錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said wallet, that's faster.
dialogue.zh: 他說退到錢包，那個比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll see it by tomorrow morning.
dialogue.zh: 明天早上你就會看到入帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, forty dollars back.
dialogue.zh: 來了，四十塊退回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, spend it or keep it saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, spɛnd ɪt ɔr kip ɪt seɪvd./
dialogue.zh: 很好，花掉或存著都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd rather pull it to my bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈræðər pʊl ɪt tə maɪ bæŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我寧可把它提回銀行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap transfer out and confirm the amount.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ˈtrænsfər aʊt ənd kənˈfɜrm ði əˈmaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 按轉出，再確認金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows a small service fee.
dialogue.zh: 它顯示有一筆小額手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dollar for transfers that small.
dialogue.zh: 這麼小的轉出只收一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free if I move a hundred.
dialogue.zh: 提滿一百塊就免手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then leave it until you need more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn liv ɪt ʌnˈtɪl ju nid mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那就先放著，等要用再提。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to splitting the trip bill.
dialogue.zh: 回到旅遊費用的分攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hotel was shared, right? Who paid first?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊˈtɛl wʌz ʃɛrd, raɪt? hu peɪd fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 旅館是大家住的吧？誰先付的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I covered the whole night.
dialogue.zh: 那一晚整筆是我付的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So three people owe you equal shares.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ θri ˈpipəl ˈoʊ ju ˈikwəl ʃɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 那有三個人欠你同樣的份額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seventy divided by four people.
dialogue.zh: 二百七除以四個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's sixty seven fifty each.
dialogue.zh: 那就是每人六十七塊五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we round up a little?
dialogue.zh: 我們要往上取整一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, make it seventy and it's easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, meɪk ɪt ˈsɛvənti ənd ɪts ˈizɪ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，湊成七十比較好算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll send a single group code.
dialogue.zh: 我發一個群組用的碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone scans it and pays you directly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn skænz ɪt ənd peɪz ju dəˈrɛktli./
dialogue.zh: 大家掃完就直接付給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that allowed for friends?
dialogue.zh: 朋友之間也能這樣用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's made for shared costs.
dialogue.zh: 可以，它就是為共同開銷做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three scanned it within a minute.
dialogue.zh: 不到一分鐘就有三個人掃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much did the group collect?
dialogue.zh: 大家一共收到多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred ten, exactly even.
dialogue.zh: 兩百一十，剛剛好平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, no one owes anyone now.
dialogue.zh: 完美，現在沒人欠誰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, did the dinner requests come back?
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ, dɪd ðə ˈdɪnər rɪˈkwɛsts kʌm bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 嘿，上週五聚餐的請款有回音了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the list for any pending name.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə lɪst fər ˈɛnɪ ˈpɛndɪŋ neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 看看清單上有沒有還掛著待付的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark still hasn't sent his share.
dialogue.zh: Mark 還沒把他的份轉來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just resend him that same request.
dialogue.zh: 就把那張請款單再傳給他一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, and I added a friendly emoji.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ənd aɪ ˈædəd ə ˈfrɛndli ɪmˈoʊji./
dialogue.zh: 傳了，我還加了個友善的表情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps, nobody likes a cold reminder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps, ˈnoʊˌbɑdi laɪks ə koʊld rɪˈmaɪndər./
dialogue.zh: 那樣有幫助，沒人喜歡生硬的催。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He paid while we were driving.
dialogue.zh: 他趁我們開車時付了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you hear your phone ping?
dialogue.zh: 你有聽到你的手機響了一聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the money shows in my log.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈmʌni ʃoʊz ɪn maɪ lɑɡ./
dialogue.zh: 有，錢已經出現在我的紀錄裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the log for your trip budget.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə lɑɡ fər jʊr trɪp ˈbʌdʒɪt./
dialogue.zh: 留著紀錄當旅遊預算用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My landlord wants a monthly code.
dialogue.zh: 我的房東想用每月轉帳碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rent by app? Is that allowed there?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛnt baɪ æp? ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 用App交房租？那裡可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says it's easier than checks.
dialogue.zh: 他說這比開支票方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make sure the note says rent July.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ʃʊr ðə noʊt sɛz rɛnt dʒʊˈlaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 記得備註要寫七月房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, a note proves what it was.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ə noʊt pruvz wʌt ɪt wʌz./
dialogue.zh: 對，備註能證明那筆是什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Especially if anyone forgets later.
dialogue.zh: 尤其之後有人記不得的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I set it to repeat each month.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt ɪt tə rɪˈpit itʃ mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 我把它設成每月重複。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, but keep your own reminder too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, bʌt kip jʊr ˈoʊn rɪˈmaɪndər tu./
dialogue.zh: 很好，不過自己也設個提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, I'll still check the amount.
dialogue.zh: 說得是，我還是會核對金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rent changed twice since we moved in.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛnt tʃeɪndʒd twaɪs sɪns wi muvd ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我們搬來後房租已經調過兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the failed charge.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，那筆失敗的扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one from the food court?
dialogue.zh: 是美食街那筆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it stayed for two days.
dialogue.zh: 對，它掛了兩天都沒消失。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So did you write to support then?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ dɪd ju ˈraɪt tə səˈpɔrt ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那後來你有找客服處理嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, they cleared it from my list.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ klɪrd ɪt frʌm maɪ lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 有，他們把那筆從清單清掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the whole list is clean now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə hoʊl lɪst ɪz klin naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 很好，清單現在完全乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you tip with a code too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju tɪp wɪð ə ˈkoʊd tu?/
dialogue.zh: 小費也可以用碼給嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some stalls print a tip square.
dialogue.zh: 有些攤位會印小費專用碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I added two dollars for him.
dialogue.zh: 我另外加了兩塊給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He saw it right on his screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɔ ɪt raɪt ɑn hɪz skrin./
dialogue.zh: 他螢幕上馬上就看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This whole month felt so tracked.
dialogue.zh: 這一個月感覺每筆都追蹤得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every dollar has a trail now.
dialogue.zh: 每一塊錢現在都有出處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I spent less than I guessed.
dialogue.zh: 我花的比我以為的還少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because you watched every small charge.
dialogue.zh: 因為你每一筆小額扣款都有在看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month I want a bigger goal.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst mʌnθ aɪ wɑnt ə ˈbɪɡər ɡoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 下個月我想設更大的目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start by saving the coffee money.
dialogue.zh: 先從省咖啡錢開始好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's nine dollars, almost every day.
dialogue.zh: 那是每天將近九塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's over two hundred a month, try it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈoʊvər tu ˈhʌndrəd ə mʌnθ, traɪ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一個月超過兩百塊，試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I owe you lunch for all this help.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ oʊ ju lʌntʃ fɔr ɔl ðɪs hɛlp./
dialogue.zh: 這些幫忙我得請你一頓午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just scan the menu and pay me.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst skæn ðə ˈmɛnju ənd peɪ mi./
dialogue.zh: 你就掃菜單上的碼付我吧。
